Therefore, for the purpose of mentioning outstanding ESOPs as on September 30, 2026, the shares held by Trust have been reduced from outstanding ESOPs in order to calculate the dillution possible from ESOPs.

6) Atyati Technologies Private Limited, has been acquired by the Company on July 2, 2026. Accordingly, it became step down subsidiary of BLS International Services Limited, Holding Company and form part of the Promoter Group for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
